Nav order: Home · Stack · Experience · Education · Projects · Connect.

Stack page is not mocked yet — it is the same grouped-chip pattern as the Stack block on the Experience cards, one section per category.

Every dark placeholder rectangle is a screenshot slot.

Dashboard captures come from a seeded demo account, never the live book.

Logos: Simple Icons (single-path, recolorable) + Devicon for Java, MATLAB, Matplotlib and AWS, which Simple Icons dropped over trademark requests.

Brand colors too dark to read on #0A0A0B are blended toward white until they pass, preserving hue.

Seven entries have no logo anywhere and use monogram tiles instead.
